theorem closed_subset_compact_perfect_countable_basis (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (A : Set X) (hA : IsClosed A) :
  ∃ P C : Set X, A = P ∪ C ∧ Perfect P ∧ Set.Countable C ∧
    ∃ B : Set (Set {x // x ∈ P}), Set.Countable B ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B := by
  haveI : SecondCountableTopology X := inferInstance
  rcases exists_countable_union_perfect_of_isClosed hA with
    ⟨C₀, P, hC₀, hP, hAP⟩
  refine ⟨P, C₀, ?_, hP, hC₀, ?_⟩
  · calc
      A = C₀ ∪ P := hAP
      _ = P ∪ C₀ := Set.union_comm _ _
  · refine
      ⟨TopologicalSpace.countableBasis {x // x ∈ P},
        TopologicalSpace.countable_countableBasis _,
        TopologicalSpace.isBasis_countableBasis _⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem closed_subset_compact_perfect_countable_basis (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (A : Set X) (hA : IsClosed A) :
  ∃ P C : Set X, A = P ∪ C ∧ Perfect P ∧ Set.Countable C ∧
    ∃ B : Set (Set {x // x ∈ P}), Set.Countable B ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B := by
  classical
  have hSecond : SecondCountableTopology X := inferInstance
  letI : SecondCountableTopology X := hSecond
  
  obtain ⟨C, P, hCcount, hP, hdecomp⟩ :=
    exists_countable_union_perfect_of_isClosed (α := X) (C := A) hA
  
  have hCompactP : IsCompact P := hP.closed.isCompact
  have hCompactSubtype : CompactSpace {x // x ∈ P} :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hCompactP
  letI := hCompactSubtype
  
  obtain ⟨B, hBcount, hBempty, hBbasis⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis {x // x ∈ P}
  
  exact
    ⟨P, C, hdecomp.trans (Set.union_comm C P), hP, hCcount,
      ⟨B, hBcount, hBbasis⟩⟩
